additionalSources.subset: Microphone signal only; 16 roots, four velocity layers, two actual alternate takes per layer. No electric pickup samples, no release-noise engine.

additionalTransforms: v24 additions: float mono conversion before per-root common peak normalization (up to 200x) and PCM16 quantization; preserve velocity-layer ratios; relative leading silence trim; 120ms linear crossfade loops for flute and cello only. Numeric pitch centers come from pinned original SFZ mapping, not octave labels. New presets balance register peaks at runtime with a bounded common gain per root; old v23 recordings and presets stay unchanged.
v28Transforms: Append-only: old 84 PCM files and records untouched. New samples converted to 44.1kHz mono float, original SFZ layer volume corrections applied before common per-root normalization, relative onset trim and 50ms end fade, then PCM16 quantization. Guitar capped at 3.8s with natural decay and no loop; violin/clarinet capped at 5s with 160ms sustain-loop crossfade. Numeric roots and fine tuning follow pinned source mappings. No synthetic alternate takes or random pitch changes.
